mechanism: Loperamide has opioid properties and phenelzine is an MAOI; combined use risks serotonin syndrome, CNS depression, and potential opioid-related adverse effects due to monoamine oxidase inhibition affecting loperamide metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if antidiarrheal therapy is necessary, consider non-opioid alternatives (bismuth subsalicylate, dietary modifications) or use different antidepressant class with appropriate washout period.
